reviews.reason: The selected Ethiopic glyphs, both asterisks, final ፡፡, and fear/alarmed/sight-of-suffering wording are supported by the supplied scans. Both footnote anchors are appropriate. However, footnote a reverses the transposition described in p55 note46: Charles restores the word after Uriel’s question, not away from that position. P56 note4 explicitly identifies this as restoration.
reviews.suggested_text: At that time Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered me and said, “Enoch, why are you so afraid and alarmed?” And I answered[a], “Because of this terrifying place and the sight of this suffering[b].”
reviews.footnote_changes: Replace footnote a: “Charles 1906 printed p56 note4 identifies the answer verb as restored and refers to p55 note46. Note46 explains that the word was wrongly transposed into the earlier clause; Charles restores it as ወአውሣእኩ after ወድንጋጼከ, at the end of Uriel’s question. This follows Charles’s restored form and placement, not independent manuscript attestation in that position.” Retain footnote b and both anchors unchanged; no Greek reading or bodily torment mechanism needs to be imported.
